name: Marpac Medical
about:
Marpac Medical operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it has produced medical devices since its spin-off from Rotec in 1992. Rotec began in the 1980s manufacturing tracheostomy tube holders and orthopedic products for DePuy; when DePuy acquired the orthopedic division, the tracheostomy holder business became the privately held Marpac.

The company manufactures FDA Class 1 medical devices, specifically endotracheal (ET) tube holders and tracheostomy tube holders. All products are designed and produced at its Albuquerque facility without outsourcing, a structure the company says allows strict quality control and rapid response to customer needs. Marpac aims to keep all items in stock and typically ships orders within one to two days.

Marpac serves the medical community, including hospitals, clinicians, and home-care patients. Its distributor network includes New Start Home Medical Equipment, Timberlake Medical, Affordable Medical Supply, and Medical Specialties Distributors.

Founded on principles of quality, affordability, innovation, and customer service, Marpac was created to develop products that improve patient care while remaining easy for medical staff and families to use.
